name: Rofanseilbahn
kurzbeschreibung: The Rofanseilbahn takes you up to the Rofanplateau, offering a breathtaking view of the turquoise-blue Achensee at 1,840 meters elevation.
preis: Bergbahn Berg- und Talfahrt ca. 26 € (Kombiticket mit Airrofan ca. 35 €)
beschreibung:
Overview

The Rofanseilbahn in Maurach at Lake Achensee operates as a premier aerial tramway whisking visitors in just five minutes into one of Tyrol's most exhilarating high-alpine adventure domains. Spanning a cable track of roughly two kilometers, the twin panoramic cabins surmount more than 850 vertical meters—gliding effortlessly from the valley station at 980 meters in Maurach up to the mountain terminal at 1,840 meters beside the historic Erfurter Hütte. The ascent itself offers an unforgettable visual experience, unfolding panoramic perspectives over the aquamarine expanse of Lake Achensee and the rugged limestone wall of the Karwendel Nature Park. Upon arrival, the lift terminal serves as the immediate gateway to a vast network of scenic walking trails, vertical via ferratas, paragliding launch pads, and alpine adventures.

Route & Requirements

The cableway itself is fully barrier-free and effortless to access (easy grade T1, completely stroller and wheelchair friendly). Directly outside the upper station, an array of attractions awaits. The headline adrenaline experience is the "Airrofan Skyglider": securely strapped into an eagle-shaped flying rig, four riders are pulled backward to the crest of Mount Gschöllkopf before soaring freely across the rock face at speeds reaching 80 km/h over a 200-meter drop (minimum height 130 cm, minimum age 10 years). Children adore the "Rofan Rondo," an alpine tubing slide gliding down curved plastic tracks. From the terminal, hikers enjoy brief strolls to the Mauritzalm chalet (10 min) or climb up to the Eagle's Nest observation platform on Gschöllkopf (45 min, grade T1/T2). Sturdy footwear and layered clothing are recommended for mountain excursions. Dogs are transported aboard cabins with leashes and muzzles.

Visit & Arrival

The lower terminal is situated along the main Achensee federal highway B181 in Maurach. Rail travelers connect via ÖBB trains into Jenbach station, boarding regional VVT bus line 4080, which halts right outside the cable car entrance. Drivers reach Maurach from the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Wiesing/Achensee) via the B181 in roughly ten minutes. Extensive free parking is reserved exclusively for cable car guests at the base terminal.

Tips

Purchase the discounted "Summit Combo Ticket," combining the return cable car journey with a flight aboard the Airrofan Skyglider. Enjoy a culinary pause at Berggasthof Rofan or Erfurter Hütte, savoring handmade Tyrolean spinach dumplings on the sun deck overlooking the lake.
